# rcodezero Provider

Manages zones on the [RcodeZero](https://www.rcodezero.at/) Anycast DNS network via its REST API v2.

## Known limitations

- Only zones are managed (`rcodezero_zone`, master and slave). RRsets and DNSSEC are not supported yet.
- The provider is configured from the provider block only, not from environment variables. Pass the token as a variable, e.g. via `TF_VAR_rcodezero_api_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    rcodezero = {
      source = "dg-i/rcodezero"
    }
  }
}

variable "rcodezero_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

provider "rcodezero" {
  api_token = var.rcodezero_api_token
  # endpoint = "https://my.rcodezero.at" # default
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) RcodeZero API token.

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Base URL of the RcodeZero API. Defaults to https://my.rcodezero.at.
